item.title: A frozen history of meandering: Mapping and modeling ice-wedge polygons on point bars
item.description: A number of meandering rivers in the Arctic, especially in Siberia, have point bars with strikingly structured permafrost polygon patterns. We use a Unet-type convolutional neural network to map the polygons.
